senses.zh_definition: 【专有名词；可能所指】萨利，皮克斯《怪兽电力公司》及相关作品中 James P. Sullivan 的昵称。
senses.en_definition: A nickname of James P. Sullivan, a fictional monster in Pixar’s Monsters, Inc. and related works.
senses.ms_definition: Nama panggilan bagi James P. Sullivan, watak raksasa fiksyen dalam filem Monsters, Inc. dan karya berkaitan terbitan Pixar.
senses.nuances: 本项为可核实的专名解释，不是 DBP 马来语普通词释义。输入没有上下文，不能确定该词例一定指此角色。若指角色，规范书写为 Sulley；不应因与英语 sully 拼写接近而赋予其“玷污”之义。[Pixar](https://www.pixar.com/monsters-inc)

etymology.historical_story: Pixar identifies Sulley as the nickname of James P. Sullivan, a celebrated scarer whose encounter with a human child changes his life. The spelling functions as a character name, rather than a Malay word assembled from productive affixes. This documented referent explains the name in film discussions, but does not establish the identity of every lowercase corpus occurrence. [Pixar](https://www.pixar.com/monsters-inc)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Sulley /ˈsʌli/ 与 Sullivan 放在一起记，再联想蓝色毛茸茸的大怪兽；记的是角色昵称，不是马来语构词。
